g.text: DDR RAM Comparison: DDR3 vs DDR4 vs DDR5
Each generation has a different notch position - NOT physically interchangeable
DDR3, DDR4, DDR5 are NOT interchangeable. Different notch positions prevent wrong insertion.
Dual-channel requires matched pairs in correct slots (A1+B1 or A2+B2). Check motherboard manual.
DDR5 has same 288 pin count as DDR4 but DIFFERENT notch. They will NOT physically fit.
Each generation: LOWER voltage (1.5V > 1.2V > 1.1V) and HIGHER speed. More efficient over time.
SO-DIMM = laptop. DIMM = desktop. Same DDR generation compatibility rules apply to both.
